property_summary: For any target address and value, the reference contract C guarantees that sendMoney reverts (or the call fails) whenever the low-level call to the target fails (i.e., it enforces the call's success), whereas the mutant removes that require and therefore can leave C's balance decreased or state unchanged when the callee fails; we detect this by using a callee that always reverts — the reference will cause sendMoney to revert (ok == false) for all amounts, while the mutant will return ok == true for some inputs (it will not revert) and thus the property is broken.
change_summary: Change the require on call result to ignore it, allowing sendMoney to succeed even if the low-level call returns false (removes require), altering balance/state observable after call.
